optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Site Project Coordinator, Solar Farm Construction
professionalSummary: Site project coordinator with three years of experience on two utility‑scale solar farm sites, managing construction schedules, daily site diaries, weekly progress reports, material delivery tracking, and milestone hand‑over documentation.
experienceHighlights: Maintained weekly construction schedules for four subcontractors on live sites.
Recorded daily site diaries and permit‑to‑work registers, audited quarterly with no findings.
Prepared weekly progress reports for developer site representatives, filed with comments.
Tracked material deliveries against schedule, resolving queries with suppliers and escalating to site project manager when needed.
Authored hand‑over condition notes at mechanical completion and grid connection milestones, countersigned by site project manager.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample includes one month of schedule updates, one week of site diary and permit‑to‑work register pages, one weekly progress report, and one milestone hand‑over note, all referenced in the site folder.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample sources establish the candidate’s activities and responsibilities on two solar farm sites, but do not provide evidence of any leadership, ownership beyond the stated responsibilities, or deployment to production environments beyond the construction sites.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review is required to assess fit for the Site Project Coordinator role.

role.roleTitle: Site Project Coordinator, Solar Farm Construction

evidence.text: Site project coordinator on two utility-scale solar farm sites for a construction contractor over three years, keeping the construction schedule current each week with the four subcontractors' reported progress.
Recorded the daily site diary and the permit-to-work register under the site procedures, with both audited quarterly by the site health and safety adviser without findings.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of diary and register recording

evidence.text: Prepared the weekly progress report for the developer's site representative, with the reports and the representative's comments filed in the site folder.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of weekly progress reporting

evidence.text: Tracked the material deliveries against the schedule in the delivery log, recording which delivery queries I resolved with the suppliers and which needed the site project manager's site instruction.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of delivery tracking and responsibility boundaries

evidence.text: Wrote the hand-over condition notes at the mechanical completion and grid connection milestones on both sites, countersigned by the site project manager.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of milestone hand-over documentation

supportedClaims.claim: Site project coordinator with three years of experience on two utility‑scale solar farm sites, managing construction schedules, daily site diaries, weekly progress reports, material delivery tracking, and milestone hand‑over documentation.
supportedClaims.witness: Site project coordinator on two utility-scale solar farm sites for a construction contractor over three years, keeping the construction schedule current each week with the four subcontractors' reported progress.

humanReviewChecklist: Verify that the candidate’s schedule updates were performed on a live construction site and not in a simulated environment.
Confirm that the weekly progress reports were delivered to the developer’s site representative and not to another stakeholder.
Clarify the extent of the candidate’s responsibility boundaries in material delivery tracking, specifically what actions required escalation to the site project manager.
